message.content: Maaf, saya perlu memverifikasi akun Anda terlebih dahulu sebelum dapat memeriksa ketersediaan produk. Silakan berikan nama pengguna dan kata sandi Anda (atau beri tahu saya jika Anda ingin menggunakan opsi “remember me”). Setelah itu, saya akan segera memeriksa stok celana dalam ukuran L yang tersedia.

They want to check if there's a product available. We need to authenticate? The tool is user_authentication_login. But we don't have credentials. The user didn't provide username/password. So we cannot call the function. We can respond asking for credentials or say we can't proceed. According to policy, we should not fabricate credentials. We can ask for username/password.
